source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014)

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: How long is the Copper T380A IUD effective, per the DOH manual?
questions.rationale: TCu 380A, used in the Philippine FP Program, is effective for 12 years; the LNG-IUS lasts 5 years.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 IUDs (PDF p. 121)
questions.quote: This type of IUD is effective for 12 years.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: How does the copper IUD mainly prevent pregnancy?
questions.rationale: The TCu 380A inhibits fertilization, sperm transport and ovum transport; it does not stop ovulation.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 How the TCu IUD works (PDF p. 123)
questions.quote: Inhibition of fertilization

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: When may a copper IUD be inserted after a vaginal birth?
questions.rationale: Insert within 10 minutes of placental delivery or within 48 hours; otherwise wait until 4 weeks or more.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Timing of IUD insertion (PDF p. 125)
questions.quote: Within 10 minutes after delivery of placenta or within 48 hours after childbirth.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A mother asks for an IUD on day 10 postpartum. The nurse explains that insertion is:
questions.rationale: From 48 hours to 4 weeks postpartum the copper IUD is MEC Category 3; insertion is delayed to 4 weeks or more.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Timing of IUD insertion (PDF p. 125)
questions.quote: IUD insertion is delayed until four weeks or more after giving birth.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Postplacental IUD insertion after a vaginal delivery is done within how long of placental expulsion?
questions.rationale: Postplacental insertion is within 10 minutes after placental expulsion; immediate postpartum is up to 48 hours.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Postpartum clients (PDF p. 131)
questions.quote: within 10 minutes after placental expulsion

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which finding after delivery means postplacental IUD insertion should be deferred?
questions.rationale: Rupture of membranes >18 hours, chorioamnionitis, unresolved PPH or genital trauma preclude insertion.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Postplacental insertion (PDF p. 132)
questions.quote: Rupture of membranes for greater than 18 hours

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which condition is MEC Category 4 for starting an IUD?
questions.rationale: Current PID, pregnancy, puerperal sepsis and purulent cervicitis are Category 4; the others are Category 1.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 MEC for IUD (PDF p. 125)
questions.quote: Current PID

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: For which client is the copper IUD a good choice with no restriction?
questions.rationale: Smoking and hypertension are MEC 1 for the copper IUD because it has no hormones.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 MEC for IUD (PDF p. 123)
questions.quote: Women who smoke at any age

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: During the pelvic exam before IUD insertion, which finding requires the nurse to defer insertion?
options: Pain when the cervix is moved
questions.rationale: Cervical motion tenderness suggests PID; insertion is deferred. A 6–8 cm uterine depth is normal.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Pelvic examination (PDF p. 127)
questions.quote: Lower abdominal tenderness when the cervix is moved (possible PID)

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which pain reliever should be avoided before IUD insertion?
questions.rationale: Aspirin slows blood clotting; ibuprofen or paracetamol may be given 30 minutes before.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Inserting the IUD (PDF p. 128)
questions.quote: Do not give aspirin because it slows blood clotting.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which practice follows the 'no-touch' technique of IUD insertion?
options: Load the IUD inside its sterile pack
Load the IUD with bare hands
Rest the IUD on the speculum
questions.rationale: The IUD is loaded in its sterile package and the sound and inserter pass the canal only once.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Preventing infection (PDF p. 130)
questions.quote: Loading the IUD into the inserter while the IUD is still in the sterile package

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: After IUD insertion, how long are the strings left hanging from the cervix?
questions.rationale: Strings are cut leaving about 3 cm so the client can check them.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Inserting the IUD (PDF p. 129)
questions.quote: leaving about 3 cm hanging out of the cervix

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Are routine antibiotics given after IUD insertion?
questions.rationale: The manual states routine antibiotics are not given to IUD users.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Inserting the IUD (PDF p. 129)
questions.quote: Do not provide routine antibiotics to IUD users.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: When should an IUD user check her strings?
questions.rationale: Strings are checked after each menses, when expulsion is most likely, and if warning signs appear.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Checking the IUD (PDF p. 130)
questions.quote: After each menses when the probability of expulsion is high

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: When teaching an IUD string check, the nurse tells the client to:
options: Feel but not pull the strings
questions.rationale: Wash hands, squat, feel for the strings and note length changes; pulling can displace the IUD.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Checking the IUD (PDF p. 130)
questions.quote: Tell the client not to pull the strings to avoid IUD displacement.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A client 2 months after IUD insertion reports cramps only during menses. The nurse should:
questions.rationale: Cramping is common in the first 3–6 months; mild menstrual cramps are managed with reassurance and a pain reliever.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Cramping (PDF p. 136)
questions.quote: Cramping is common within the first three to six months of IUD use.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: An IUD user is pregnant and her strings are visible. What is the best action?
questions.rationale: After ruling out ectopic pregnancy, a visible-string IUD is removed to reduce infection, miscarriage and preterm birth.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Pregnancy with IUD (PDF p. 137)
questions.quote: Remove the IUD gently by pulling the strings.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: An IUD user is diagnosed with PID and wants to keep the IUD. What is advised?
questions.rationale: PID is treated with antibiotics; immediate removal is unnecessary unless she wishes or she does not improve.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 PID (PDF p. 138)
questions.quote: The immediate removal of the IUD is unnecessary.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which sign during insertion suggests uterine perforation?
questions.rationale: Sharp pain and loss of resistance to the sound or inserter suggest perforation; stop the procedure.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Uterine perforation (PDF p. 139)
questions.quote: Loss of resistance to upward pressure of inserter or uterine sound

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A client asks to have her IUD removed after 6 months. The provider should:
options: Ask her to wait a year
questions.rationale: The provider must not refuse or delay removal or pressure the client to continue; offer other methods.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 IUD removal (PDF p. 140)
questions.quote: the provider should not refuse or delay the removal

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which is an advantage of IUD insertion right after delivery?
questions.rationale: Immediate postpartum insertion assures non-pregnancy and convenience, though expulsion is higher than interval insertion.
questions.source: DOH Philippine Clinical Standards Manual on Family Planning (2014), Ch. 6 Immediate postpartum insertion (PDF p. 135)
questions.quote: Assurance that the client is not pregnant.
